local name = "Roberto"
print("Hello, " .. name)

local fruits = { "apple", "pear", "plum" }
for i, fruit in ipairs(fruits) do
  print(i, fruit)
end

local name = "Lua"
local count = 0
count = count + 1
print(name, count)

if score >= 90 then
  print("A")
elseif score >= 80 then
  print("B")
else
  print("C")
end

for i = 1, 5 do
  print(i)
end

for i = 10, 1, -2 do
  print(i)
end

local function add(a, b)
  return a + b
end

print(add(2, 3))

local user = { name = "Ann", age = 31 }
for key, value in pairs(user) do
  print(key, value)
end

local text = "Hello World"
print(string.upper(text), #text)
print(text:sub(1, 5), text:find("World"))

local function counter()
  local n = 0
  return function()
    n = n + 1
    return n
  end
end

local next_id = counter()

local co = coroutine.create(function(a)
  local b = coroutine.yield(a * 2)
  return a + b
end)

print(coroutine.resume(co, 5))

local n = 0
while n < 3 do
  n = n + 1
  print(n)
end

local first, last = "Ada", "Lovelace"
print(first .. " " .. last)
print(string.format("%s has %d chars", first, #first))

local ready = true
local value = nil
if ready and not value then
  print("waiting")
end

local function sum(...)
  local total = 0
  for _, n in ipairs({ ... }) do
    total = total + n
  end
  return total
end

local nums = { 5, 2, 8, 1 }
table.sort(nums, function(a, b) return a > b end)
table.remove(nums, 1)
print(table.concat(nums, ", "))

local ok, err = pcall(function()
  error("something broke")
end)
if not ok then
  print("caught: " .. err)
end

local Animal = {}
Animal.__index = Animal

local Dog = setmetatable({}, { __index = Animal })
Dog.__index = Dog

function Dog:speak()
  return "woof"
end
